'''Kei Shindō''' (Japanese: '''真堂圭''' ''Shindō Kei'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. 

==Biography==
Shindō was born on September 10, 1984, in {{wp|Chiba City}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Shindō began her work during {{aniseries|DP}}, where her major roles include {{DL|Lyra (anime)|Chikorita|Lyra's Chikorita}} and various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. In {{aniseries|XY}}, she picked up the role of [[Miette]], replacing Saori Hayashi halfway into the [[series]]. In {{aniseries|SM}}, Shindō's roles include {{an|Lillie}}, one of {{ashcl|Ash's classmates}}; and {{DL|Acerola|On hand|Acerola's Mimikyu}}, [[nickname]]d Mimikins. Shindo is currently affiliated with the talent group Axlone.
